title: SSH configured
recommendation: Configure SSH for secure remote administration.

title: SSH Version 2
recommendation: Configure SSH Version 2.

title: SSH authentication retries limited
expected: SSH authentication retries are explicitly limited.
recommendation: Limit SSH authentication retries.

title: SSH idle timeout configured
expected: SSH idle timeout is explicitly configured.
recommendation: Configure an SSH idle timeout.

title: Telnet disabled
expected: VTY transport input is SSH only.
recommendation: Remove Telnet from VTY transport input and permit SSH only.

title: VTY session timeout
expected: VTY exec-timeout is configured and not unlimited.
recommendation: Configure a reasonable VTY session timeout.
applicability: Applies to each configured VTY line block.

title: AAA enabled
recommendation: Enable AAA and configure the approved authentication method.

title: Privileged local administrator exists
expected: At least one local user has privilege 15.
recommendation: Create an approved privileged local administrator account.

title: Enable secret configured
recommendation: Configure an approved enable secret.

title: VTY management ACL
expected: Every VTY block has an access-class.
recommendation: Restrict VTY access with an approved management ACL.

title: HTTP management disabled
recommendation: Disable the HTTP management server unless explicitly required.

title: Management SVI has an IP address
expected: An active management SVI has an IP address.
recommendation: Configure the approved management SVI address.

title: Secure SNMP version
expected: SNMP is absent or configured as v3.
recommendation: Use an approved SNMPv3 configuration.

title: No default SNMP community
recommendation: Remove default community strings.
remediation: no snmp-server community public ; no snmp-server community private

title: Remote logging configured
expected: At least one remote logging destination.
recommendation: Configure an approved centralized syslog server.

title: NTP server configured
recommendation: Configure an approved NTP server.

title: Port security on active access ports
recommendation: Enable port security on active access ports.

title: Port-security maximum MAC limit
expected: An explicit maximum MAC address limit is configured.
recommendation: Configure an explicit port-security maximum.
applicability: Applies when port security is enabled on an active access interface.

title: Secure port-security violation mode
recommendation: Configure an approved port-security violation action.
applicability: Applies when port security is enabled on an active access interface.

title: PortFast on active access ports
recommendation: Enable PortFast on appropriate active edge/access ports.

title: BPDU Guard on active access ports
recommendation: Enable BPDU Guard on appropriate active edge/access ports.

title: Broadcast storm control on active access ports
recommendation: Configure broadcast storm control.

title: Multicast storm control on active access ports
recommendation: Configure multicast storm control.

title: DHCP Snooping enabled
expected: DHCP Snooping enabled with VLAN scope.
recommendation: Enable DHCP Snooping on protected VLANs.
remediation: ip dhcp snooping ; ip dhcp snooping vlan <vlan-list>

title: DAI enabled for protected VLANs
recommendation: Enable Dynamic ARP Inspection on applicable VLANs.

title: IP Source Guard on DHCP access ports
recommendation: Enable IP Source Guard on applicable DHCP access ports.
applicability: Applies to active access interfaces with a DHCP snooping rate limit.

title: Restricted trunk VLAN list
recommendation: Restrict trunk allowed VLANs to only those required.

title: Non-default native VLAN
recommendation: Configure an approved unused/native VLAN.

title: DHCP Snooping trust on approved uplink
expected: DHCP Snooping trust on approved uplink.
recommendation: Trust only the approved DHCP/uplink interface.
applicability: Applies only to trunk interfaces classified as approved uplinks.

title: DAI trust on approved uplink
recommendation: Trust only the approved DAI/uplink interface.
applicability: Applies only to trunk interfaces classified as approved uplinks.

title: Unused interfaces disabled
recommendation: Shut down unused interfaces and place them in the approved unused VLAN.
applicability: Applies to interfaces whose description identifies them as UNUSED.
